data.title: Mom Calls Out School for Making an AI-Generated Photo of 6-Year-Old Daughter as an Adult (Exclusive)
data.description: Nikki Anderson was surprised when her 6-year-old daughter came home from school with an AI-generated photo of what she could look like at 25 years old. “[6-year-olds] are already capable of imagining futures that adults couldn’t possibly predict. Why are we outsourcing that?” Anderson asks.
